questions.q_en: Pipe Q can fill the tank in 60 hours while pipe R may fill in 45 hours. Q and R pipes are opened together for 6 hours after which pipe W is also opened to empty the tank. All three pipes are opened simultaneously for 24 hours to reach the half level mark. How much time (in hours) will pipe W alone take to empty the entire tank?
questions.solution_en:
Pipe Q can fill it in 60 hours

Pipe R can fill it in 45 hours

L.C.M of 60 and 45 is 180

Efficiency of Q and R is :-

Q's efficiency = 180/60=3

R's efficiency= 180/45=4

So in first 6 hours work done= (4+3)*6=42 units

Remaining=180-42=138 units

Let efficiency of pipe W be 'w, as three pipes work for 24 hours and reach half level mark

So 1/2 of 180=90, and as 42 is already completed, so remaining=90-42=48

So, 24*(3+4-w)=48

w=5,

so time taken by w alone to complete= 180/5=36 hours

questions.q_en: X can do a job in 18 hours, and Y in 24 hours. They work together for 't' hours, after which X stops. Y alone then takes 10 hours more to finish. Find 't'.
questions.solution_en:
Let the work be LCM (18, 24) = 72 units.

Efficiency X = 4, Y = 3 units/hr.

Work by Y alone in 10 hours = 3 X 10 = 30 units.

Work done together = 72 - 30 = 42 units.

Combined rate = 4 + 3 = 7 units/hr.

Time together (t) = 42 / 7 = 6 hours.
questions.solution_hi:
Let the work be LCM (18, 24) = 72 units.

Efficiency X = 4, Y = 3 units/hr.

Work by Y alone in 10 hours = 3 X 10 = 30 units.

Work done together = 72 - 30 = 42 units.

Combined rate = 4 + 3 = 7 units/hr.

Time together (t) = 42 / 7 = 6 hours.

questions.q_en: Average of marks obtained by students of a class is taken as 78 which is wrong and 0.5 more than the actual average as marks of two students A and B taken wrong which are 88 and 80. If there are 40 students in the class, then what is the correct average of marks obtained by A and B together?
questions.solution_en:
Number of students = 40

Wrongly taken average = 78

Actual average = 78 - 0.5 = 77.5

Let correct average of marks obtained by A and B together = a

Then, 40 * 77.5 = 40 * 78 - 88 - 80 + 2a

a = 74

questions.q_en: The radius of the base of a cylinder is 14 cm and its curved surface area is 880 cm2. Its volume (in cm3) is: (Take π = 22/7)
questions.solution_en:
Let height of the cylinder = 'h' cm

Curved surface area = 2πrh

880 = 2 * (22/7) * 14 * h

h = 10 cm

Volume of cylinder = πr2h

= (22/7) * 142 * 10

= 6160 cm3

When 6 sweets from box A put in box B, then number of sweets in both boxes is equal. If 21 sweets from box B is transferred to box A, then number of sweets in box A becomes thrice the number of sweets in box B. Find the ratio of number of sweets in box A to that of box B.
questions.solution_en:
Let the number of sweets in box B = m

The number of sweets in box A = m + 6 + 6 = m + 12

(m + 12) + 21 = 3(m - 21)

m + 33 = 3m - 63

2m = 96

m = 48

So, the ratio of number of sweets in box A to that of box B = (48 + 12):48 = 60:48 = 5:4

questions.q_en: A man completed certain journey by a car. If he covered 30% of the distance at a speed of 30 km/hr, 60% distance at 20 km/hr and the remaining distance at 5 km/hr then what was his average speed during the entire journey?
questions.solution_en:
Let the total distance = 100a km

Time taken to cover 30% of distance at 30 km/hr = 30a/30 = a hour

Time taken to cover 60% of distance at 20 km/hr = 60a/20 = 3a hour

Time taken to cover 10% of distance at 5 km/hr = 10a/5 = 2a hour

Hence average speed = 100a/(a+3a+2a) = 16.67 km/hr

questions.q_en: Two pipes X and Y can fill a tank in 20hrs and 30hrs respectively while a third pipe Z can empty the full tank in 40hrs. All the 3 pipes are opened in beginning and after 10 hrs Z is closed. Then find, in total how much time will the tank be full?
questions.solution_en:
Tank filled in 10hrs=10*(1/20+1/30-1/40)=7/12

Remaining part=1-(7/12)=5/12

Work done by (X+Y) in 1 hour=(1/20+1/30)=1/12.

Now 1/12 part is filled by (X+Y) in 1 hour.

5/12 part will be filled by (X+Y) in =(5/12)*12=5hours

Therefore total time in which the tank is full=10+5=15hrs.

questions.q_en: Charan was initially riding on his motor bike at a speed of 24 kmph. He increased his speed by 3 kmph at the end of every hour. Find his average speed for the first eight hours of journey.
questions.solution_en:
Speed in nth hour = 24 + (n - 1) 3 = (3n + 21) kmph.

Total distance travelled by him in eight hours = 24 + 27 +... + (3(8) + 21)

= 8/2 [2(24) + (8 - 1) 3] = 4(48 + 21) = 276km.

Therefore average speed of Charan = 276/8 = 34.5 kmph.

Hence the correct option is (2).

questions.q_en: Base of a pyramid is circular, and its lateral height is 25 cm. If lateral surface area of pyramid is 550 cm2, then find the volume of pyramid.
questions.solution_en:
Let radius of base of pyramid = 'r' cm

Lateral surface area of pyramid = (1/2) * Perimeter * Lateral height

550 = (1/2) * 2 * (22/7) * r * 25

r = 7 cm

Height of pyramid = √(252 - 72) = 24 cm

Volume of pyramid = (1/3) * Base area * Height

= (1/3) * (22/7) * 72 * 24

= 1232 cm3

Note: Pyramid with circular base is commonly known as cone.
